name: Cisco ASA
description: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance. VPN, packet capture, AAA/RADIUS, NAT, routing, failover, and ASP diagnostics.
notes: Most commands require enable mode.
Use 'terminal pager 0' if output stops at a pager prompt.
Run 'terminal monitor' in an SSH session to see debug output there.
Debug output can be CPU intensive. Every debug runbook includes cleanup commands.
The capture buffer is increased to 32 MB after the capture is created: capture TSTCAP buffer 33554432.

workflows.title: Packet capture — host to host
workflows.summary: Create a 32 MB circular capture on an interface, generate traffic, then display the packets.

steps.command: capture TSTCAP interface {iface} match ip host {src} host {dst}
steps.note: Creates a 32 MB circular buffer named TSTCAP.

steps.instruction: Generate the traffic, then run the display command.

steps.note: Shows the path and NAT decisions for packet 1.

cleanup.note: Stops the capture and frees the buffer.

notes: Use a larger buffer if the traffic burst is high.
The capture name is fixed (TSTCAP) so cleanup is predictable.

workflows.title: Packet capture — TCP or UDP port
workflows.summary: Capture a single application flow between two hosts and one port.

steps.command: capture TSTCAP interface {iface} match {proto} host {src} host {dst} eq {port}

steps.instruction: Reproduce the application problem now.

notes: For a range of ports, use an ACL capture instead.

workflows.title: Packet capture — subnet to subnet
workflows.summary: Capture all traffic between two subnets using ASA wildcard masks.

steps.instruction: Generate traffic, then display the buffer.

notes: This can fill quickly on busy segments. Narrow to a host pair when possible.

workflows.title: Packet capture — with a temporary ACL
workflows.summary: Build a temporary ACL for a protocol and host pair, attach it to a capture, then remove both.
steps: access-list TSTCAP_ACL extended permit {proto} host {src} host {dst}

steps.instruction: Generate traffic, then inspect the capture.

notes: Useful for ESP (protocol 50) when a simple host match is not enough.

workflows.title: Connectivity check
workflows.summary: Ping, trace, route lookup, and ARP lookup for a target.

workflows.title: Packet-tracer — TCP flow
workflows.summary: Simulate a TCP flow through ACLs, NAT, routing, and inspection without sending traffic.
notes: Read the result from the bottom up: NAT, route, ACL, inspection, then the final action.

workflows.title: Packet-tracer — ICMP echo
workflows.summary: Check whether an ICMP echo request would be allowed and routed.

workflows.title: VPN session inventory
workflows.summary: Summarize AnyConnect and site-to-site sessions, then inspect details.

workflows.title: VPN user lookup
workflows.summary: Find a user's AnyConnect session and related authentication log lines.

workflows.title: IKEv2 debugs — connection failures
workflows.summary: Enable IKEv2 protocol and platform debugs, reproduce the failure, then inspect logging.

steps.note: Shows debug and log output in this SSH session.

steps.instruction: Attempt the VPN connection now, then inspect the log.

notes: IKEv2 debug flags are global, not per-peer.
If you are connected over SSH, use 'show logging' or ASDM to read the output.

workflows.title: IPsec debugs — tunnel and SA issues
workflows.summary: Inspect IPsec security associations and enable IPsec debug output for a peer.

steps.instruction: Send traffic through the tunnel, then check the SAs and logs.

workflows.title: AnyConnect debugs — connection and login
workflows.summary: Enable AnyConnect/WebVPN debugs and inspect session establishment.

steps.instruction: Reconnect the AnyConnect client, then read the output.

workflows.title: RADIUS debugs — all users
workflows.summary: Enable RADIUS debugging for every authentication attempt and watch the output.

steps.instruction: Trigger the authentication attempt, then inspect the log.

notes: This is global. Use the single-user runbook when many users are authenticating.

workflows.title: RADIUS debugs — one user
workflows.summary: Filter RADIUS debugging to a single username and find that user's log lines.

steps.instruction: Have the user authenticate now, then inspect the log.

notes: If this ASA release rejects 'debug radius user', use the all-users runbook.

workflows.title: Test RADIUS authentication
workflows.summary: Check server reachability, inspect the AAA group, and run a test authentication.

steps.note: The ASA prompts for the test password; it is not stored by TSTerm.

notes: Confirm the server group tag exactly with 'show aaa-server'.

workflows.title: NAT and connection lookup
workflows.summary: Look up translations and connections for a source, then trace the flow.

workflows.title: Routing protocol status
workflows.summary: Inspect routes plus OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP neighbors in one pass.
notes: Some commands are absent when that routing protocol is not enabled.

workflows.title: Failover and HA health
workflows.summary: Check failover state, history, and monitored interfaces.
notes: Not all platforms support every failover subcommand.

workflows.title: System health snapshot
workflows.summary: Version, CPU, memory, connections, ASP drops, and recent logs.

workflows.title: ASP drop investigation
workflows.summary: Inspect the ASP drop counters and the paths that are dropping packets.

workflows.title: DHCP debugs
workflows.summary: Inspect DHCP bindings and enable DHCP daemon packet debugging.

steps.instruction: Renew the client lease, then inspect the log.

workflows.title: Packet capture — ASP drops
workflows.summary: Capture packets dropped by the accelerated security path and read the drop reason.

steps.instruction: Reproduce the drop, then read the captured frames.

notes: This is the fastest way to prove why the ASA is dropping traffic.
The capture name is fixed so the cleanup is predictable.

workflows.title: Packet capture — decrypted VPN traffic
workflows.summary: Capture traffic after decryption, including AnyConnect or IPsec flows.
steps: capture TSTCAP interface {iface} include-decrypted match ip host {src} host {dst}

steps.instruction: Generate the VPN traffic, then inspect the capture.

notes: The include-decrypted option shows the plaintext payload as well as the tunnel headers where supported.

workflows.title: Packet capture — IPsec ESP on the outside
workflows.summary: Capture encrypted ESP packets for a peer with a temporary ACL.
steps: access-list TSTCAP_ACL extended permit esp host {peer} host {local}

steps.instruction: Send traffic through the tunnel, then inspect the capture.

notes: Use the capture-decrypted runbook to see the inside plaintext at the same time.

workflows.title: Packet-tracer — UDP flow
workflows.summary: Simulate a UDP flow such as DNS, RADIUS, syslog, or DTLS.
notes: Read the final result and the phase where the packet would stop.

workflows.title: Local-host and connection lookup
workflows.summary: Find the local-host entry, connections, translations, route, and ARP for an address.

workflows.title: DNS and FQDN diagnostics
workflows.summary: Inspect DNS trusted sources, the DNS cache, and the resolution state for a name.
notes: The ASA only resolves names that are activated for FQDN use or configured as objects.

workflows.title: DNS resolver debugs
workflows.summary: Enable DNS resolver debugging while a name is being resolved.

steps.instruction: Trigger the name resolution, then inspect the output.

workflows.title: ICMP trace debugging
workflows.summary: Watch ICMP packets being sent and received by the ASA.

steps.instruction: Run the ping or reproduce the ICMP issue, then inspect the trace.

workflows.title: ARP debugs
workflows.summary: Watch ARP requests, replies, and ARP table updates.

steps.instruction: Generate traffic to the unresolved host, then inspect the ARP output.

workflows.title: NAT debugs
workflows.summary: Watch NAT translation decisions while reproducing a flow.

steps.instruction: Reproduce the connection, then inspect NAT and xlate state.

workflows.title: Connection table — host view
workflows.summary: Inspect connection details for a host and locate the translation and local-host entry.

workflows.title: VPN sessions — filter by user
workflows.summary: Filter AnyConnect sessions to one username and inspect the user log lines.

workflows.title: VPN session — detail by index
workflows.summary: Read a single VPN session by its session index.
notes: Run the summary first if you do not know the index.

workflows.title: AnyConnect and WebVPN profile state
workflows.summary: Inspect WebVPN counters, AnyConnect images, group URLs, and group policy configuration.

workflows.title: WebVPN and AnyConnect debugs
workflows.summary: Enable WebVPN AnyConnect, session, and request debugs for a connection failure.

steps.instruction: Reconnect the client, then inspect the output.

workflows.title: IKEv1 and IPsec status
workflows.summary: Inspect IKEv1 SAs, statistics, and IPsec state.

workflows.title: IKEv1 and IPsec debugs
workflows.summary: Enable IKEv1 and IPsec debugs for a tunnel that will not come up.

steps.instruction: Bring the tunnel up or send traffic, then read the output.

workflows.title: IKEv2 and IPsec status
workflows.summary: Inspect IKEv2 SAs in detail, IKEv2 stats, IPsec state, and protocol counters.

workflows.title: IPsec SA and peer status
workflows.summary: Inspect all IPsec SAs, global statistics, and a specific peer if supplied.

workflows.title: Site-to-site VPN health
workflows.summary: Collect LAN-to-LAN sessions, IKEv2 SAs, IPsec SAs, tunnel groups, and crypto map configuration.

workflows.title: VPN certificates and keys
workflows.summary: Inspect identity certificates, trustpoints, trustpool, CRLs, and the device public key.

workflows.title: SSL and TLS status
workflows.summary: Inspect SSL policy, cipher lists, errors, session cache, and object statistics.

workflows.title: VPN load balancing
workflows.summary: Check whether VPN load balancing is configured and see its state.
notes: On a standalone ASA this normally reports that load balancing is not configured.

workflows.title: User-Identity and IP mapping
workflows.summary: Inspect User-Identity memory, groups, statistics, and the user-to-IP mapping for a supplied user or address.

workflows.title: TACACS+ debugs
workflows.summary: Enable TACACS+ session and user debugging for an authentication or authorization failure.

steps.instruction: Attempt the login or command, then inspect the output.

workflows.title: LDAP debugs
workflows.summary: Enable LDAP debugging for directory authentication or User-Identity failures.

steps.instruction: Trigger the LDAP lookup, then inspect the output.

workflows.title: AAA authentication and authorization debugs
workflows.summary: Enable AAA authentication, authorization, accounting, and common debugs.

steps.instruction: Trigger the login or command authorization, then inspect the output.

workflows.title: AAA server groups by protocol
workflows.summary: Inspect RADIUS, TACACS+, LDAP, and all AAA server groups.

workflows.title: AAA and management access audit
workflows.summary: Review AAA server configuration, local usernames, current privilege, SSH sessions, and SSH policy.
notes: The output can include usernames and access policy. Treat it as sensitive.

workflows.title: OSPF status
workflows.summary: Inspect OSPF neighbors, interfaces, database, RIB, statistics, and learned routes.

workflows.title: EIGRP status
workflows.summary: Inspect EIGRP neighbors, interfaces, and learned routes.

workflows.title: BGP status
workflows.summary: Inspect the BGP summary, neighbor detail, BGP table, and learned routes.

workflows.title: BGP debugs
workflows.summary: Enable BGP shim debugging while a neighbor or route is failing.

steps.instruction: Reset or refresh the neighbor, then inspect the output.

workflows.title: EIGRP packet and neighbor debugs
workflows.summary: Enable EIGRP packet and neighbor debugging.

steps.instruction: Reproduce the neighbor issue, then inspect the output.

workflows.title: Multicast status
workflows.summary: Inspect multicast routes, MFIB, IGMP groups, and PIM neighbors and interfaces.

workflows.title: IPv6 status
workflows.summary: Inspect IPv6 interfaces, routes, neighbors, and traffic counters.

workflows.title: Route table summary
workflows.summary: Summarize the route table by source and inspect ARP statistics.

workflows.title: NAT and xlate detail
workflows.summary: Inspect NAT rules, pools, translations, and xlate counters.

workflows.title: ACL hit counts and bindings
workflows.summary: Show ACL hit counters, element counts, and interface bindings.

workflows.title: Object and object-group inventory
workflows.summary: Inspect network and service objects and object-group counts.

workflows.title: Inspection and service policy
workflows.summary: Inspect global and interface service policies, inspect drops, and connection details.

workflows.title: DHCP server status
workflows.summary: Inspect DHCP daemon state, bindings, and statistics.

workflows.title: Interface detail and counters
workflows.summary: Inspect one interface, its counters, the IP summary, and detailed link state.

workflows.title: ARP, MAC, and bridge table
workflows.summary: Inspect ARP entries and statistics plus the bridge/MAC table.

workflows.title: Failover detail
workflows.summary: Inspect failover state, history, interface state, statistics, and monitored interfaces.

workflows.title: Clustering status
workflows.summary: Inspect cluster state, resource usage, history, and cluster ACL counters.
notes: On a standalone ASA this reports that clustering is not configured.

workflows.title: Hardware, boot, and storage
workflows.summary: Inspect inventory, version, boot variables, disk/flash contents, and memory blocks.
notes: Inventory output includes the device serial number.

workflows.title: NTP, clock, and logging
workflows.summary: Inspect NTP state, the clock, syslog settings, queue health, and logging configuration.

workflows.title: SNMP status
workflows.summary: Inspect SNMP engine ID, groups, hosts, users, statistics, and configuration.

workflows.title: Smart Licensing and call-home
workflows.summary: Inspect Smart Licensing registration, entitlements, usage, UDI, and call-home profiles.
notes: Smart Account and virtual account names may be sensitive.

workflows.title: Threat detection and shun state
workflows.summary: Inspect basic and scanning threat detection rates, shunned hosts, memory, and configuration.

workflows.title: NetFlow export status
workflows.summary: Inspect NetFlow export counters and destination, active, delay, and template configuration.

workflows.title: Processes and memory detail
workflows.summary: Inspect CPU-hungry processes, per-process memory, system memory detail, and block usage.

workflows.title: SSH, ASDM, and management access
workflows.summary: Inspect SSH and ASDM sessions, ciphers, images, and management configuration.

workflows.title: Configuration and evidence audit
workflows.summary: Collect the running and startup configuration plus key operational tables for review.
notes: Configuration output can include secrets, keys, and personal data. Review before sharing outside your team.
This runbook is read-only but can produce a large amount of output.

workflows.title: Collect TAC support evidence
workflows.summary: Collect version, configuration, logging, and the full tech-support bundle for a TAC case.
requires: enough local disk space for the tech-support file
notes: show tech-support can take several minutes and load the device. Run it during a maintenance window when possible.
The output can be very large and may contain sensitive configuration.
